image_description: A high-angle view of an ornate church altar situated within a baldachin (canopy) supported by four teal and gold twisted columns. The altar table is covered with a white cloth and holds religious items including candles and a central tabernacle. Behind the altar is a large painting of a religious figure. In the foreground, a blue and white balustrade separates the viewer from the sanctuary space.

The coffered pattern on the underside of the canopy shows very slight warping in the perspective lines, though it largely adheres to the vanishing point. It is subtle but noticeable upon close inspection.
